# Global Strategy

Selected work analyzing competitive advantage, financial performance, strategic positioning, leadership, and the tradeoffs organizations face as they grow and adapt.

## Featured Work

### Costco: Value Proposition, Target Customers, and Cost Leadership in Practice

A strategic analysis of how Costco's membership model, customer selection, and cost leadership strategy reinforce one another to create a durable competitive advantage.

[Read the publication →](costco/index.qmd)

### IKEA in China: Adapting a Global Model

A global strategy analysis of how IKEA adapted its standardized model to Chinese consumer expectations, competitive pressures, and changing market conditions.

### Ron Ventura at Mitchell Memorial Hospital: Clinical Excellence, Leadership Accountability, and Contract Renewal

A strategy and leadership analysis of how a hospital should balance exceptional clinical performance, organizational culture, physician development, financial value, and accountability when deciding whether to renew a high-performing physician leader.

[Read the publication →](ron-ventura/index.qmd)

### Starbucks vs. The Boston Beer Company: A Financial and Strategic Analysis

A comparative analysis of Starbucks and The Boston Beer Company across financial performance, competitive position, leadership execution, and strategic outlook from FY2023 through FY2025.

[Read the publication →](starbucks-vs-boston-beer/index.qmd)

### Shopify’s Strategic Pivot: Preserving Today’s Advantage While Building Tomorrow’s

A strategic analysis of Shopify’s return to an asset-light commerce platform, the rise of AI-driven shopping, and the challenge of balancing enterprise scale, small-business trust, and financial-services risk.
